steps.title: After hyperdimensional Slash cast starts
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: If you are in FirstSlashTargets: Stand on waymark 2; otherwise: Stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

OffTank.rule: When FirstSlashTargets includes OT and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand on waymark 3; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out OT and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets includes OT and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand on waymark 2; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out OT and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: When FirstSlashTargets leaves out H1 and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets includes H1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand on waymark 2; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out H1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets includes H1 and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand on waymark 1.

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstSlashTargets has ShieldHealer).

MeleeDpsA.rule: When FirstSlashTargets includes M1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out R2, stand on waymark 1; when FirstSlashTargets includes M1 and FirstSlashTargets includes R2, stand on waymark 3; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out M1 and FirstSlashTargets includes R2, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out M1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out R2, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on FirstSlashTargets has MeleeDpsB and SecondDimension: no & Empty → near B (S 5m); yes & Full → at 4; yes & Empty → at 1; no & Full → near B (S 5m).

PhysRangedDps.rule: When FirstSlashTargets includes R1 and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand on waymark 4; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out R1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets includes R1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand on waymark 1; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out R1 and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: If you are in FirstSlashTargets: Stand on waymark 4; otherwise: Stand near waymark B, 5m south of the centre.

steps.title: After hyperdimensional Slash resolves
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: HeavensblazeTarget).

MainTank.rule: If you are in FirstSlashTargets: Stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre; otherwise: Stand on waymark B.

OffTank.rule: When FirstSlashTargets includes OT and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out OT and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand on waymark C; when FirstSlashTargets includes OT and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out OT and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand on waymark B.

ShieldHealer.rule: When FirstSlashTargets leaves out H2 and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand on waymark C; when FirstSlashTargets includes H2 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre; when FirstSlashTargets leaves out H2 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out MT, stand on waymark A; when FirstSlashTargets includes H2 and FirstSlashTargets includes MT, stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstSlashTargets has MeleeDpsA).

PhysRangedDps.rule: When HeavensblazeTarget leaves out R1 and FirstSlashTargets includes R1, stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre; when HeavensblazeTarget leaves out R1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out R1, stand on waymark A; when HeavensblazeTarget includes R1 and FirstSlashTargets leaves out R1, stand on waymark D.

CasterDps.rule: If you are in FirstSlashTargets: Stand near waymark 2, 5m north of the centre; otherwise: Stand on waymark D.
